findings.text: follow-on: _current_review_in_flight composes `expected` write_paths from the installed code and matches them against the review pointer's granted paths; this change moves the composed paths from the store to <reviewed-run>/review-records, so a hand-launched review dispatched before the code moved (granted store paths) is no longer recognised as in flight and the run it reviews could be re-dispatched while that review is live — narrow (needs an in-place upgrade with a live hand-launched review) and the reflex path is checked first, so it does not hold this node.
